"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-units 📐"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Unit conversion toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — **22 categories, 3 tools, zero runtime dependen"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cies**, pure arithmetic over a static unit table (no network, no filesystem, no code execution)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"When your agent needs to answer *"how many miles is 100 km?"*, *"is 1 MB bigger than 1 MiB?"*, *"is "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"100 Mbps the same as 100 MB/s?"*, *"what's 350°F in Celsius?"*, *"how many tablespoons in 2 cups?"*,"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" *"16px is how many pt?"*, *"20 mpg in L/100km?"*, *"150 kW is how much mechanical horsepower?"*, *""},{"id":"p4s4","text":"how many g is 9.8 m/s²?"*, *"100 CFM in m³/h?"*, *"is $3.99/lb cheaper than $8.50/kg?"* or *"500 g f"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"or $4.29 vs 1 lb for $3.59?"* — instead of doing error-prone mental math, it can call these tools an"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"d read exact results."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 中文简介：dsh-units 是 DeepSeek Harness 的单位换算工具箱插件，覆盖长度、质量、温度、面积、体积（含美制烹饪单位）、速度、时长、数据大小（十进制 MB 与二进制 MiB "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"严格区分）、数据传输速率（Mbps 与 MB/s 严格区分）、加速度（g-force）、照度（lux / 英尺烛光）、压强、能量、角度、频率、功率（机械/公制/电动马力严格区分）、力、扭矩、排版印刷（"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"px/pt/em/rem）、体积流量（m³/s、L/min、CFM、US gpm）、密度（kg/m³、g/cm³、lb/ft³、lb/gal）、油耗（L/100km ↔ mpg ↔ km/L）共 22"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" 个类别，并提供单价归一与比价工具，零运行时依赖、纯算术实现，无网络无副作用。让 Agent 不再心算——特别是"MB/MiB 混淆""100 Mbps 不等于 100 MB/s""华氏摄氏互转""加"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"仑换升""mpg 与 L/100km 互算""三种马力混淆""$3.99/lb 与 $8.50/kg 哪个便宜"这类高频出错点，直接调用工具拿精确结果。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why it exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **LLMs are unreliable at unit math.** Temperatures are affine (offset), data sizes mix decimal and"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" binary prefixes, fuel economy is reciprocal (mpg vs. L/100km), and compound units (km/h, psi, kcal)"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" hide awkward factors. A wrong conversion silently corrupts reports, recipes, travel plans, and capa"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"city math.
- **Fully deterministic and offline.** Every factor lives in the static table in `src/uni"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ts.ts` — no API keys, no lookup services, nothing to drift.
- **Structured results.** Each conversio"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n returns the original value, both units (symbol + full name), the result, the formula applied, and "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"the category — so the agent can explain its math instead of just asserting it."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `convert_unit` | Convert `value` from one unit to another within a category. Accepts symbols or fu"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ll names (case-insensitive, °C, m², "miles", "MiB" all work). Rejects unknown units and cross-catego"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ry pairs with clear errors. |
| `list_units` | List all 22 categories with every unit symbol and ful"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"l name (optionally one category, e.g. `"data"` or `"temperature"`) — for discovering the exact symbo"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ls to pass to `convert_unit` and `unit_price`. |
| `unit_price` | Normalize and compare unit prices:"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" pass 1–6 offers as `{ price, per, quantity? }` (`quantity` defaults to 1, so `{ price: 4.29, per: ""},{"id":"p10s7","text":"g", quantity: 500 }` is a 500 g pack) and get the price of one target unit for each offer (default: "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"the category base unit), the cheapest offer and the spread in percent. Rejects temperatures (affine)"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" and fuel economy (reciprocal) instead of returning a meaningless number. |
| `unit_sum` | Add up 1–"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"12 quantities that share one category, each in its own unit, and get the total and the mean in a tar"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"get unit (default: the category base unit). Built for "5 ft 3 in + 1.2 m + 80 cm" and "1 h 30 min 45"},{"id":"p10s12","text":" s" without mental conversion: every quantity is converted to the base unit and summed with compensa"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ted (Neumaier) accumulation, so a long list of small addends does not drift. Negative values are all"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"owed, so it answers differences too. Rejects temperatures (affine) and fuel economy (reciprocal). |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Supported categories"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Category | Units (symbols) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| length | km, m, cm, mm, um, nm, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi |
| mass | t (metric tonne), kg, g, mg, lb, oz"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" |
| temperature | c, f, k — affine conversion with offsets |
| area | km2, ha, m2, cm2, mm2, mi2, a"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"cre, yd2, ft2, in2 |
| volume (incl. cooking) | m3, l, ml, cm3, gal, qt, pint, cup, floz, tbsp, tsp "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"(US units) |
| speed | km/h, m/s, mph, knot, ft/s |
| time duration | yr (Julian, 365.25 d), wk, d, "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"h, min, s, ms |
| data size | tbit…bit, pb…b (decimal), pib…kib (binary) — **MB ≠ MiB** |
| data tra"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"nsfer rate | tbit/s…bit/s (decimal bits), tb/s…b/s (decimal bytes), tib/s…kib/s (binary bytes) — **1"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"00 Mbps = 12.5 MB/s** |
| acceleration | m/s2, g0 (standard gravity 9.80665 m/s²), ft/s2, mph/s — g-"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"force & automotive |
| illumination | klx, lx (lux), fc (foot-candle), ph (phot) — 1 fc = 10.76391 l"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"x |
| pressure | mpa, kpa, bar, atm, psi, mmhg, torr, pa |
| energy | kwh, wh, kcal, kj, cal, j, ev "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"|
| angle | deg, rad, grad |
| frequency / rotation | ghz, mhz, khz, hz, rpm |
| typography (CSS / p"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"rint) | px, pt, pc (pica), em, rem — 96 dpi reference, 16 px base font for em/rem |
| fuel economy |"},{"id":"p13s12","text":" l/100km, l/km, mpg (US), mpg(uk) (imperial), km/l — reciprocal, **mpg ≠ linear** |
| power | mw, kw"},{"id":"p13s13","text":", w, hp (mechanical = 550 ft·lbf/s), hp(m) (metric PS), hp(e) (electric 746 W), btu/h (IT), ftlb/s —"},{"id":"p13s14","text":" **three different horsepower definitions** |
| force | kn, n, dyn, lbf, kgf (kp), gf — lbf/kgf are "},{"id":"p13s15","text":"weight-based at standard gravity 9.80665 m/s² |
| torque | n.m, kgf.m, lbfft (pound-force foot), lbf"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"in (pound-force inch) — force × length |
| volumetric flow rate | m3/s, m3/h, l/s, l/min, l/h, cfm ("},{"id":"p13s17","text":"cubic foot per minute), gpm (US gallon per minute) — **flows, not volumes** |
| density | kg/m3, g/l"},{"id":"p13s18","text":" (identical to kg/m³), g/cm3 (= g/mL = kg/L = t/m³), g/ml, kg/l, t/m3, lb/ft3, lb/gal — **lb/gal is "},{"id":"p13s19","text":"m³), g/cm3 (= g/mL = kg/L = t/m³), g/ml, kg/l, t/m3, lb/ft3, lb/gal — **lb/gal is 119.8264 kg/m³** |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"or clone and build locally:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
